title: A new book by a good friend … Birthing the Symbiotic Age
excerpt: My friend Richard Flyer releases his important new book to the world today. I highly recommend it! https://www.richardflyer.com/p/its-live-birthing-the-symbiotic-age Richard’s sincerity, insight, honesty, intelligence, and experience as an organizer/activist all shine through…
body:
My friend Richard Flyer releases his important new book to the world today. I highly recommend it! https://www.richardflyer.com/p/its-live-birthing-the-symbiotic-age

 Richard’s sincerity, insight, honesty, intelligence, and experience as an organizer/activist all shine through in this book. I am so grateful this labor of love is available and I hope it finds the widest possible audience.
